fusions.name: Sparks Underfoot
fusions.desc: Strikes sparks from your hooves, dealing 4 fire damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and setting each [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Burnt Offering
fusions.desc: Butts a target at or below 30% health for 18 fire damage, consuming every affliction on it to add 1.6 times their remaining damage to the hit, then sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Walk the Coals
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 20% and your fire resistance by 30% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Stubborn Embers
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. Your fire resistance rises by 10%.
